simple.meaning: נַעֲרָן (Naʻărân) is a Hebrew word meaning “Naaran , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H5295. Naaran נַעֲרָן proper name, of a location in E of Ephraim , 1Chr 7:28 ( ᵐ5 Νααρναν , A Νααραν , ᵐ5 L Νοαραν ), apparently = [ נַעֲרָה ] q. v. נֹף see מֹף .

occurrences.englishText: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;
